Terms & Conditions

Last Updated: [04/10/2026]

Welcome to PakkaJob.in (“Website”, “Platform”, “PakkaJob”, “we”, “us”, or “our”).

PakkaJob.in is an online employment platform intended to help job seekers discover employment opportunities and connect with employers, recruiters, agencies, and organizations. These Terms & Conditions (“Terms”) govern your access to and use of PakkaJob.in and its related services.

By accessing, registering on, or using PakkaJob.in, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to these Terms. If you do not agree with these Terms, please do not use the Website or its services.

1. Nature of Our Services

PakkaJob.in provides an online platform that may allow users to:

Search and view job vacancies.

Create and maintain a job-seeker profile.

Upload or create a resume.

Apply for jobs.

Receive job recommendations, alerts, calls, SMS, WhatsApp messages, emails, or other communications relating to employment opportunities.

Allow employers or recruiters to view information provided by job seekers.

Allow employers and recruiters to publish job vacancies.

Connect job seekers with prospective employers or recruiters.

PakkaJob.in is primarily intended to make the job-search process easier. PakkaJob.in does not itself guarantee employment, interviews, selection, joining, salary, promotion, or any other employment outcome.

2. No Guarantee of Job or Interview

PakkaJob.in does not guarantee or warrant:

That a job seeker will receive an interview.

That an employer will contact a job seeker.

That a job seeker will be selected for any position.

That a job seeker will receive a job offer.

That an employer will hire or retain any job seeker.

The salary, benefits, working conditions, location, duties, or other terms offered by an employer.

That any job vacancy will remain available after it is posted.

That every job listing or employer information will always be accurate, complete, genuine, or current.

The final decision regarding interviews, selection, employment, salary, and other employment terms belongs solely to the employer or recruiter.

3. Job Seekers

If you use PakkaJob.in as a job seeker, you agree to provide truthful, accurate, and updated information.

You should not provide:

False educational or employment information.

Fake experience or qualifications.

False identity information.

Misleading salary or job history information.

Another person's resume or personal information without permission.

Documents or information that you do not have the legal right to provide.

You are responsible for checking the accuracy of information submitted through your profile, resume, applications, or other communications.

4. Employers and Recruiters

Employers, recruiters, consultants, agencies, and other organizations using PakkaJob.in must provide accurate information about their organization and job vacancies.

Employers and recruiters should not:

Publish fake or misleading jobs.

Collect unlawful payments from job seekers.

Misrepresent salary, job duties, location, working hours, or employment conditions.

Use job-seeker information for unlawful purposes.

Harass or threaten job seekers.

Request unnecessary confidential information from job seekers.

Use PakkaJob.in to promote illegal activities.

PakkaJob.in may remove, suspend, or restrict any job listing, employer account, recruiter account, or user account that we believe violates these Terms or applicable law.

5. Important Warning About Job Frauds

PakkaJob.in does not guarantee the authenticity of every person, recruiter, consultant, employer, or job opportunity available through the Platform.

Job seekers should exercise caution before accepting a job offer or sharing sensitive information.

Never make a payment solely because someone claims that payment is required to obtain a job, interview, appointment letter, registration, training, security deposit, document verification, uniform, equipment, or any other employment-related benefit.

PakkaJob.in will not be responsible for losses resulting from payments, transactions, communications, or agreements made directly between a job seeker and an employer, recruiter, consultant, or other third party.

If you receive a suspicious job offer or communication claiming to represent PakkaJob.in, please contact us through our official contact channels.

6. Employer Contact

By creating a profile, uploading a resume, applying for a job, or otherwise using our services, you understand and agree that employers, recruiters, or other authorized users may contact you using the contact details or communication methods you have provided.

Such communication may include:

Telephone calls.

SMS.

WhatsApp or other messaging services.

Email.

In-platform notifications.

Other electronic communications.

You may receive communications relating to jobs, applications, interviews, recruitment opportunities, and related services.

7. Resume and Profile Visibility

Depending on the services and privacy settings available on PakkaJob.in, information provided by you may be made available to employers, recruiters, or other authorized users for recruitment purposes.

You understand that once information is shared with an employer or recruiter, PakkaJob.in cannot guarantee how that third party will store, use, copy, or retain such information.

You should therefore avoid including unnecessary sensitive information in your resume or public profile.

8. User Information

When you register or use our services, we may collect information such as:

Name.

Mobile number.

Email address.

Location.

Education.

Work experience.

Skills.

Job preferences.

Resume information.

Application information.

Device and technical information.

IP address.

Information relating to your use of the Website.

We may use such information to provide, operate, improve, personalize, and secure our services and to facilitate communication between job seekers and employers.

Our collection and use of personal information is also governed by our Privacy Policy.

9. Accuracy of Job Information

We may receive job information from employers, recruiters, agencies, partners, or other sources.

Although we may take reasonable steps to maintain the quality of job listings, we do not guarantee that every listing is:

Accurate.

Complete.

Current.

Available.

Genuine.

Suitable for a particular user.

Job seekers should independently verify important details such as employer identity, job location, salary, duties, working hours, fees, and employment conditions before accepting an offer.

10. User Conduct

You agree to use PakkaJob.in only for lawful purposes.

You must not:

Create a fake account or impersonate another person.

Provide false or misleading information.

Upload fraudulent documents.

Upload content that is illegal, threatening, abusive, defamatory, obscene, or discriminatory.

Harass, threaten, or abuse another user.

Send spam or unsolicited commercial messages.

Collect or misuse another user's personal information.

Attempt to access another user's account.

Attempt to bypass the security of the Website.

Introduce viruses, malware, or harmful code.

Use bots, spiders, scrapers, or automated systems without our written permission.

Copy, reproduce, or commercially exploit Website content without permission.

Use the Website for fraud, scams, money laundering, or other unlawful activities.

Publish jobs that are illegal or misleading.

Use the Platform to sell or promote unrelated products or services without authorization.

We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these requirements.

11. Account Security

If you create an account, you are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials.

You should immediately notify us if you believe that:

Someone has accessed your account without permission.

Your password has been compromised.

Your account is being misused.

You are responsible for activity conducted through your account unless caused by circumstances for which you are not legally responsible.

12. Payments and Paid Services

Certain services offered by PakkaJob.in may be paid services.

Where applicable:

Prices will be communicated before purchase.

Payments may be required in advance.

Applicable taxes may be charged.

Payment processing may be handled by third-party payment providers.

Refunds, if applicable, will be governed by our Refund/Cancellation Policy.

Purchasing a paid service does not guarantee an interview, job offer, selection, joining, or employment.

PakkaJob.in will never represent that payment guarantees a job.

13. Third-Party Services and Links

The Website may contain links, advertisements, services, or information provided by third parties.

PakkaJob.in does not control and is not responsible for third-party websites, applications, products, services, employers, recruiters, advertisements, or communications.

Your dealings with third parties are between you and that third party.

14. User-Generated Content

Users may submit resumes, profiles, photographs, job postings, messages, reviews, comments, or other content.

You remain responsible for the content you submit.

By submitting content to PakkaJob.in, you grant us a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free right to host, store, reproduce, display, process, format, and use that content as reasonably necessary to operate and provide our services, subject to our Privacy Policy.

You confirm that you have the necessary rights and permissions to submit the content.

15. Intellectual Property

The PakkaJob.in name, logo, website design, graphics, software, text, trademarks, service marks, and other original materials belonging to PakkaJob.in or its licensors are protected by applicable intellectual property laws.

You may use the Website for legitimate personal or business purposes in accordance with these Terms.

You may not copy, reproduce, modify, distribute, sell, publish, reverse engineer, or commercially exploit our Website or proprietary content without our prior written permission.

16. Website Availability

We will make reasonable efforts to keep PakkaJob.in available and functioning.

However, we do not guarantee that:

The Website will always be available.

The Website will always operate without interruption.

The Website will be completely error-free.

All information will always be accurate or current.

The Website will be free from viruses or other harmful components.

The Website may occasionally be unavailable because of maintenance, upgrades, technical problems, security issues, or circumstances beyond our reasonable control.

17. Limitation of Liability

To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, PakkaJob.in and its owners, employees, affiliates, partners, and service providers will not be responsible for losses arising from:

Failure to obtain employment.

Failure to receive an interview.

Rejection of an application.

Actions or conduct of an employer or recruiter.

Fake or fraudulent job offers made by third parties.

Payments made by users to third parties.

Inaccurate information supplied by another user.

Loss or misuse of information caused by third parties.

Third-party websites or services.

Technical failures or interruptions.

Unauthorized access caused by circumstances beyond our reasonable control.

Nothing in these Terms excludes or limits liability that cannot legally be excluded or limited under applicable law.

18. Indemnification

You agree, to the extent permitted by law, to indemnify and hold harmless PakkaJob.in, its owners, employees, officers, affiliates, and service providers from claims, losses, damages, liabilities, costs, and expenses arising from:

Your violation of these Terms.

Your unlawful use of the Website.

False or misleading information submitted by you.

Your violation of another person's rights.

Your violation of applicable laws.

Content submitted or published by you.

19. Account Suspension and Termination

We may suspend, restrict, or terminate your access to PakkaJob.in if:

You violate these Terms.

You provide false or misleading information.

Your account is involved in fraud or misuse.

Your activities may harm other users or the Website.

We are required to do so by law.

We reasonably believe that continued access creates a security, legal, or operational risk.

You may also stop using the Website or request closure of your account, subject to applicable policies and legal requirements.

20. Privacy

Your use of PakkaJob.in is also subject to our Privacy Policy.

Please review the Privacy Policy to understand how we collect, use, store, disclose, and protect personal information.

By using the Website, you acknowledge that you have read and understood the Privacy Policy.

21. Changes to These Terms

We may modify these Terms from time to time.

Updated Terms may be published on the Website. Your continued use of PakkaJob.in after changes are published will constitute acceptance of the revised Terms, to the extent permitted by applicable law.

22. Governing Law and Jurisdiction

These Terms shall be governed by and interpreted in accordance with the laws of India.

Subject to applicable law, disputes relating to these Terms or your use of PakkaJob.in shall be subject to the jurisdiction of the courts at Bangalore City, State, India].

23. Contact Us

If you have questions, complaints, concerns, or reports regarding these Terms, job listings, suspicious activity, or misuse of the Platform, please contact us through the contact details provided on PakkaJob.in.
